history.topic: Describe your ideal weekend and what makes it enjoyable. Use one specific example.
history.transcript: My ideal weekend is slow in the morning and social in the afternoon. I like to wake up without an alarm and then walk to a small bakery near my place and get a coffee. And then in the afternoon I usually meet a friend, and then we go for a walk by the river. In the evening I like to cook something simple and read for a bit. I think it works because I get a bit of quiet time and a bit of time with people.
